description: Run a Project's agents as a company: create the organization with the user one question at a time, then the employee protocol every desk and ticket session follows (trigger blocks, the ticket board, channel etiquette, budgets), plus the CEO, HR and finance playbooks — mission to tickets, hiring and calendars, budgets and cost audits — and the mirror protocol for a company of digital twins that relays between real people.
description_zh: 把 Project 里的 Agent 组织成一家公司：先与用户一问一答地创建组织，再是每个工位会话与工单会话都遵循的员工协议（触发块、工单看板、频道礼仪、预算），以及 CEO、人事与财务的操作手册——使命拆解为工单、招募与日程、预算与成本巡检——还有让数字分身在真人之间传话的镜像协议。
short_description: Company setup plus the employee, CEO, HR, finance and mirror playbooks.
short_description_zh: 创建组织，以及员工、CEO、人事、财务、镜像公司的操作手册。
